section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex templates used as governing structural schema for proposal writing
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes/impacts not present in Tier 2B
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, budget figures) not present in Tier 3
Commencing Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions
Finalising proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without flagging the gap
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1-4 inputs
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional

check_notes.13.1: Artifact is a Phase 6 phase output (schema_id orch.phase6.implementation_architecture.v1). Content references 'grant-agreement implementation provisions' and Tier 1 grant_agreement_implementation_articles only as normative/citation grounding, never as a structural schema authority. Instrument section structure (3, 3.1, 3.2, 6, 8) is derived from Tier 2A section_schema_registry.json (MSCA-PF application form), not from any Grant Agreement Annex, Model Grant Agreement Annex, or AGA template. No structural authority is drawn from an annex.
check_notes.13.2: Call-requirement claims (research integrity/good scientific conduct, Career Development Plan obligation, training/Open Science) carry Tier 2B references in the traceability footer: scope_requirements.json (SR-04, SR-05) and call_constraints.json (CC-09, CC-10), both under docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/. The ethics-review flag is explicitly and honestly qualified as a Tier 3 compliance_profile.json derivative flag with 'no Tier 2B extracted source path currently cites an ethics review as a topic-specific mandate,' i.e. not asserted as an invented call constraint. Applicability: pass.
check_notes.13.3: Project-specific facts (partners HOST/ELTE, DATA_PARTNER/MATE, TRANSFER_PARTNER/MVCRI, VALIDATION_PARTNER/AgroVIR; role tokens FELLOW/SUPERVISOR/CO_SUPERVISOR; WP leads; Steering Group seat; 30-month duration; host_country HU) are grounded via traceability_footer.primary_sources pointing to docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/partners.json, consortium/roles.json, call_binding/compliance_profile.json, and call_binding/selected_call.json. Every project-fact carries a Tier 3 source reference.
